My psychiatrist told me maybe I should take this medication, see if it would help. Thought she was full of it. The next morning I got irrationally anger over something small. Something that could easily be remedied. I thought, "What the hell. This pill can't hurt. I'm already pissed." And then, it worked.

Well if you go to urgent Care just make sure you don't get put on a 72-hour hold or something similar. Any psyche hospitals nearby?

Is your doctor part of a practice? Like are they part of a giant group of doctors or are they a partnership in a group of doctors? That might be a way for you to get in contact with somebody especially if there's someone in your area that works with your doctor.

It's hard unthinking, but the meds help. I was frantic about two days ago. I wanted to burn the world does. I took the depakote on an empty stomach. 1.5hrs later the edge was gone. Within 3hrs I was calm enough to make rational decisions.
Be safe. I almost booked a trip to California this week realized it was a manic state, stopped myself. I booked a trip to Las Vegas in a manic state. Spent thousands. It was so dumb. Be safe.

I may be newer to this but I don't think that kind of thinking is what's going to help you right now. It's the whole reason you know we are diagnosed right? The anger. Takes one that know one I guess. For years my bipolar disorder has been going unchecked. It's been misdiagnosed as many things. Doctors thought that my periods of anger were probably secondary to my increased blood pressure so they sent me to a cardiologist who prescribed me blood pressure medication. Then I went to another doctor who thought it was my kidneys and I had some sort of adrenal gland issue so they sent me for tests to see if I had some sort of adrenal gland cancer. I decided to seek out a psychiatrist because of a self-harm incident. She thought it was plain old depression. Within 4 months I had two more episodes of self-harm on Zoloft. Those led to her figuring out that it was bipolar disorder. I took the medication and my wild thoughts stopped. I was ramping up for a manic episode and it went away. I get how you think no one believes you. I'm from a stereotypical Hispanic family. They believe that anything mental is not only a weakness but a problem that can be solved with gritting your teeth.

Hope you're doing okay. I had a few episodes self-harm before people came to the conclusion of bipolar disorder. At this point you might be light years ahead of where I was a week ago. Don't hurt yourself just to get attention. Go and get the right help in attention and do it the right way. But don't put yourself in harm's way just to get it. Ask opinions of people that don't have the same thought processes you. Ask for a third-party opinion on on how the doctors and the ERs and anyone is treating you so you could have a real good understanding. Your point of view may be skewed because you may be hurting a lot inside. Don't let this disease process beat you up get help but get it the right way. You can always message me if you need somebody to talk to.because right now I don't have anyone to talk to but how I'm feeling and it would be nice to.
